# VoometDesign — Full Overview

> Comprehensive architectural, interior design, and fenestration capabilities of VoometDesign, Bangalore.

## Introduction
VoometDesign is an established interior design and fenestration company headquartered on Outer Ring Road, Marathahalli, Bangalore, Karnataka. Operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, and educational sectors, the company delivers complete turnkey interior solutions from initial 3D design concept to on-site civil execution, MEP engineering, factory furniture fabrication, and final handover.

## Commercial & Corporate Office Interiors
VoometDesign engineers high-performance office environments for technology startups, multinational corporations, and co-working spaces in Bangalore's premier IT corridors including Whitefield, Electronic City, Outer Ring Road, and Bellandur.
Key capabilities include:
- Agile modular workstations with integrated wire management.
- Acoustic meeting rooms and conference hubs with verified NRC ratings.
- Executive boardrooms, reception lounges, and breakout zones.
- Turnkey MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and HVAC engineering.
- Rapid handover schedules to minimize commercial lease vacancy costs.

## Luxury Residential & Villa Interiors
VoometDesign crafts bespoke residential living spaces across Bangalore's luxury residential developments and standalone villas:
- Living spaces, master suites, and contemporary walk-in wardrobes.
- German-hardware modular kitchens with heat and moisture-resistant finishes.
- Turnkey delivery with standard execution schedules of approximately 45 days.
- In-house factory joinery ensuring millwork precision without on-site dust or delays.

## Hospitality Interior Design
Specialized architectural and interior design services for hotels, resorts, fine dining restaurants, and boutique cafes:
- High-RevPAR boutique hotel guestrooms and luxury suites.
- High-traffic hotel lobbies, banquet halls, and reception areas.
- Acoustic isolation between guestrooms and public entertainment zones.
- Commercial kitchen MEP planning and compliance with fire safety codes.

## Educational & Campus Interiors
Purpose-built educational environments designed to foster student collaboration and engagement:
- Ergonomic classrooms and lecture halls with durable, non-toxic materials.
- Modern STEM laboratories, computer centers, and digital libraries.
- Early childhood preschool layouts with child-safe edges and vibrant acoustics.

## Architectural Fenestration (Aluminium & UPVC)
Factory-direct precision fenestration systems:
- Slimline sliding aluminium doors and panoramic structural glazing.
- Thermal-break aluminium profiles designed for maximum energy efficiency.
- Multi-chamber acoustic UPVC windows with double and triple glazing for urban noise cancellation.
- Heavy-duty European multi-point locking hardware.
